quarterly_data.quarter: Bristol Myers Squibb press release: Bristol Myers Squibb Announces Positive Topline Results (09-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Positive topline results from the registrational Phase 2 QUINTESSENTIAL trial of arlocabtagene autoleucel (arlo-cel; BMS-986393), an autologous GPRC5D-directed CAR T cell therapy, in quadruple-class exposed relapsed and refractory multiple myeloma: the study met its primary endpoint of overall response rate (statistically significant and clinically meaningful) after four or more prior lines and the key secondary endpoint of complete response rate, plus the key secondary endpoints of ORR and CRR after three or more prior lines; safety was consistent with other CAR T and GPRC5D-targeting therapies. BMS says QUINTESSENTIAL is the first pivotal trial in quadruple-class exposed RRMM after prior BCMA-targeted therapies; results are to be presented at an upcoming medical meeting.
